title: Retinoic Acid Alleviates Accelerated Atherosclerosis in Diesel Exhaust-Derived PM2.5-Exposed ApoE-/- Mice by Enhancing eNOS-NO Coupling.
snippet: Respiratory exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5), including diesel exhaust particles (DEPs), is a major air pollutant associated with pulmonary inflammation and cardiovascular diseases. This study investigated the protective effects and underlying mechanisms of retinoic acid (RA) against PM2.5-induced lung injury and accelerated atherosclerosis. Diff...
